Planning notice: Old King Road

A public planning meeting for 25 & 31 Old King Road, Nobleton is scheduled for November 30, 2026 at 6 p.m. Read the Township notice for the proposal and participation details.

The Township’s fall dining event includes participating restaurants across Nobleton, King City and Schomberg. Check the official announcement for menus and reservations.
